title: 💻 Process stdin

messages.content: process.stdin is a stream that represents the standard input for a Node.js process. It is used to read data from the console or any other input source that is piped into the Node.js process. process.stdin is a Readable Stream, which means it provides an interface for reading data from a source in a streaming manner. It is often used in conjunction with process.stdout (standard output stream) and process.stderr (standard error stream) to interact with the user or perform data processing tasks.
